final_notes:
SETTLED:
1. Score = points / height of the taller tower. Blocks are compared by position. Extra or missing blocks lower the score.
2. Colour words: nove blue, muva orange, vonu green, fuza yellow, kano red, tumu purple.
3. The builder makes one block per colour word, bottom up, default star. Right colour with wrong shape gives 0.25. Right colour and star gives 1.0.
4. Repeated colour words give repeated blocks. A shape word right after a colour modifies that block and adds no block.
5. Shape words: tido = BALL, melu = CUBE, loku = CONE, kuru = RING. All confirmed. The new partner uses the same mapping. This round they sent vonu fuza tido vonu fuza tido fuza tido, I built 5 blocks correctly, and the score was 0.56 (5/9).
6. The 8-word cap is the main limit. A shape word costs one word and gains 0.75 on its block. Blocks without a shape word fall back to star.
7. Colour-only messages are full marks only for all-star targets. Otherwise about 0.25-0.5.
8. Targets with 8-10 blocks cap around 0.3-0.6. A long run of one colour can't be compressed.
9. Mixed targets with stars: leave star blocks bare and spend shape words on the non-star blocks.

OPEN / NOT WORKING:
1. Whether star has its own word. Zeki, neto, dobo gave stars. Mape gave no cone.
2. Unknown: fidi, vepu, and a shape word placed before a colour.
3. There is no way to say repeat N times beyond repeating the colour word.
4. A tall target loses the top blocks. This round the 4 top blocks were never covered, because the words ran out.
5. It is unclear whether covering the top blocks with bare colour words would have beaten perfect lower blocks.

TRY NEXT:
1. As sender, count words first: blocks + shape words must be 8 or fewer. Spend shape words on non-star blocks.
2. For tall targets, compare an exact bottom against a rough full-height message. A bare colour word on a top block is worth about 0.25 for a wrong shape, or 1.0 if the target is a star.
3. Test fidi or vepu as a possible star word on a short target.
4. As builder, read a word after a colour as that block's shape and build exactly that. Report anything unusual.

SETTLED:
1) Score is 1 per exact block, 0.25 if only colour or only shape matches, divided by the taller tower's height. Max 8 words, 16-word list only.
2) Colour words: kano=red, fuza=yellow, nove=blue, muva=orange, vonu=green, tumu=purple.
3) Each colour word makes one block, in order, and the default shape is star. Repeated colour words make runs. Targets over 8 blocks lose the last blocks, and a 10-block target caps the score at 0.8.
4) tido=ball, kuru=ring, melu=cube. Each follows a colour word, adds no block, applies only to the preceding colour block, and costs one word of budget. Reconfirmed this round: vonu fuza tido vonu fuza tido fuza tido gave green star, yellow ball, green star, yellow ball, yellow ball.
5) A shape word does not carry over to later blocks of the same colour.
6) Word meanings are the same across partners, and builders read them as I do.
7) Colour-only messages score about 0.25 per block when target shapes are not stars, and 1 per block when they are stars.
8) With shape words, 8 words give only about 5 blocks if every block needs one. A 9-block target then scores at most about 0.56 even if all 5 are exact.

OPEN:
1) loku is probably cone, seen working twice, but unconfirmed.
2) How to split the 8-word budget between colour and shape words on long targets. A shape word on a block gains 0.75 but costs one block, so it is worth it only if the target has few blocks to lose.
3) Whether zeki, dobo, neto, vepu, fidi, mape are filler or other shapes. mape gave no cone.

NEXT:
1) Star targets: colour words only.
2) Long target: compare two plans. Plan A is colour words only, giving about 0.25 or 1 per block over 8 blocks. Plan B is shape words on the non-star blocks, giving fewer blocks. Pick whichever has more expected points divided by target height.
3) Put the shape word right after its colour. Test loku for cone again when a cone is needed.
4) As builder, read tido as ball, kuru as ring, melu as cube, loku as cone, and note any new shape results.
5) Test one unknown word per round after a colour and record the built shape.
